metadata.title: Retail investors may be selling hot AI stocks to buy shares of SpaceX - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 days ago
Retail investors may be selling hot AI stocks to buy shares of SpaceX
Retail investors seem eager to buy shares of SpaceX, but that money has to come from somewhere. So investors are taking profits and selling some of the hot semiconductor stocks that have done well in recent weeks, possibly to fund their purchases of SpaceX, according to data from Vanda Research.
"It may not be coincidental that as retail investors gear up for the SpaceX IPO, we've also seen a sharp liquidation of recent AI winners. The chart for [1-month] rolling retail flows in Micron is pretty stunning — we've gone from ≈$350mn net buying to ≈$250mn net selling," Vanda wrote in a note.
Vanda said it wouldn't be surprising to see further retail selling of previously popular stocks — including Micron, Sandisk, Marvell and the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X ETF — to invest more money into SpaceX.
